title: Poonam Dixit v. State of U.P. And 3 Others
coram: Siddhartha Varma and Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed; apply under Clause 6.5(a) within 10 days, decide in one month.
headnote: Writ alleging that no electricity connection was ever taken in the petitioner's name disposed of without examining merits. Petitioner directed to apply under Clause 6.5(a) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code within ten days; the authority to decide within one month.
facts: Poonam Dixit filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court stating that she had never taken any electricity connection in her name and was aggrieved by a connection standing against her. Counsel for the Electricity Department submitted that any such mistake could be rectified by approaching the relevant authority under Clause 6.5(a) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code. The Court heard counsel for the petitioner, the Standing Counsel, and the Electricity Department.

holding_units.holding: Without examining merits, a writ complaining that no electricity connection was ever taken in the petitioner's name is disposed of by directing that if she applies under Clause 6.5(a) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code within ten days, the authority shall decide the application within one month.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner had never taken an electricity connection in her name
not_decided.note: Court expressly declined to go into merits and relegated the petitioner to Clause 6.5(a).
